objective_for_doctor:
Age: 48
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: stridor

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’ve had a high-pitched sound when breathing in, and it feels like stridor. I also had a cold in the last 2 weeks.
How old are you, and are you having any difficulty swallowing or drooling?
I don’t know.
Do you have a barking cough that sounds like a seal, or is your cough normal-sounding?
I don’t know.
Is your voice hoarse, or does it sound more muffled like you have a hot potato in your mouth?
I don’t know.
Are you able to breathe comfortably right now, or are you struggling to get enough air?
I’m not sure. I’ve noticed a high-pitched sound when breathing in. I also had a cold in the last 2 weeks.
Do you have a fever right now, and if so, how high is it?
I don’t know. I’ve had a cold in the last 2 weeks, and I smoke cigarettes and am exposed to secondhand cigarette smoke daily.
Is the high-pitched breathing sound constant, or does it come and go? And did it start suddenly or gradually over days?
I don’t know. But I’ve noticed the high-pitched sound when breathing in, and I had a cold in the last 2 weeks. I also smoke cigarettes and I’m exposed to secondhand cigarette smoke daily.
Do you have any pain in your throat, or does it hurt to swallow?
I don’t know.
Do you need to sit upright or lean forward to breathe more easily, or can you lie down comfortably?
I don’t know. I’ve noticed a high-pitched sound when breathing in, and I had a cold in the last 2 weeks. I also smoke cigarettes and I’m exposed to secondhand cigarette smoke daily.
Did the high-pitched breathing start suddenly (over minutes to hours) or develop gradually over several days?
I don’t know. I’ve noticed a high-pitched sound when breathing in, and I had a cold in the last 2 weeks. I also smoke cigarettes and I’m exposed to secondhand cigarette smoke daily.
Can you speak in full sentences right now, or do you get out of breath after just a few words?
I don’t know. I’ve noticed a high-pitched sound when breathing in, and I had a cold in the last 2 weeks. I also smoke cigarettes and I’m exposed to secondhand cigarette smoke daily.

[ABSTAIN] Unable to determine severity or distinguish between life-threatening and benign causes of inspiratory stridor without age, onset timing, fever, dysphagia, voice quality, or respiratory distress markers.

[POSSIBLE] Acute epiglottitis, acute laryngotracheobronchitis (viral croup), bacterial tracheitis, laryngeal edema/angioedema, retropharyngeal abscess
